parameters.content:
## ResearchForge V2 × n8n
One runtime only: n8n submits and reads `/v2/research-runs`; it does not own retrieval, finance, prompts, state or validation.

Web, MCP and n8n share the same official filing discovery, document cache, Research State, report and Trace.

Failure stays explicit; n8n never invents a result or reruns a failed task automatically.
